title: Enable the module
description: Controls build-time registration of Mermaid support.
purpose: Disable every package integration at build time when false.
explicitNegatives: mermaidContent is rejected and is not deprecated.

occurrences.precedence: Explicit module value overrides the package default.

default.summary: The module is enabled by default.

reset.summary: Omit the property to restore true.

lifecycle: Read while the Nuxt module is set up.
errorSemantics: A non-boolean fails module configuration validation.

supportedConstraint.summary: Only the module surface accepts this build-time switch.

recommendedRange.summary: Use either boolean according to deployment needs.

localValidation.summary: The package accepts only booleans and rejects the runtime occurrence.

title: Debug mode
description: Controls package diagnostics and two Mermaid initialization defaults.
purpose: Expose detailed logging and rendered Mermaid errors while diagnosing integration problems.
boundary: Package-owned closed option; Mermaid owns downstream log semantics.

default.summary: Debug mode is off by default.

reset.summary: Omit the property to restore false.

lifecycle: Resolved into the immutable runtime snapshot.

supportedConstraint.summary: Boolean debug state selects package-owned conditional defaults.

title: Loader
description: Groups Mermaid initialization and lazy-loading transport.
purpose: Configure how Mermaid is initialized and when a diagram starts rendering.
boundary: Closed package group with one delegated payload child.

occurrences.precedence: Runtime override wins by property presence.
Overrides module options by property presence.

title: Mermaid initialization
description: Carries the strict pure-data Mermaid configuration initialized by the package.
purpose: Transport Mermaid initialization data while preserving package-set safety defaults.
boundary: Open delegated descendants under a package-owned boundary.

occurrences.precedence: Runtime values override module values and defaults.

default.summary: Package defaults plus debug-derived fields unless explicitly overridden.

reset.summary: Omit fields to restore package and debug-derived defaults.

lifecycle: Validated as strict data, merged by property presence, cloned, and frozen before use.
errorSemantics: Unsafe transport values fail before Mermaid receives them.

title: Lazy loading
description: Chooses eager rendering or viewport-triggered rendering.
purpose: Delay diagram rendering until it intersects the viewport.

default.summary: Lazy loading is enabled by default.

reset.summary: Omit to restore true.

lifecycle: Evaluated when the renderer chooses its loading trigger.
errorSemantics: Values other than boolean or the closed object fail validation.

title: Lazy threshold
description: Sets the IntersectionObserver threshold used for lazy rendering.
purpose: Choose how much of a diagram must intersect before rendering begins.
boundary: Package validates the number; the browser owns threshold behavior.

default.summary: The package does not supply a threshold.

reset.summary: Omit to delegate the default to IntersectionObserver.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { loader: { lazy: { threshold: 0.25 } } }

lifecycle: Passed to the lazy observer when it is created.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts finite or non-finite JavaScript numbers at local field validation after strict-data validation permits finite numbers only.

recommendedRange.summary: Use the browser-supported interval from 0 through 1.

localValidation.summary: Strict-data transport rejects non-finite numbers; field validation requires number.

title: Theme
description: Groups package theme selection values.
purpose: Select light and dark Mermaid themes.

deprecation.summary: The group is active; one child is a deprecated no-op.

title: Legacy color-mode switch
description: Accepted for 3.0 compatibility but has no effect.
purpose: Allow old 3.0 configuration to remain accepted during migration.

deprecation.summary: Accepted but intentionally ignored; this is the only deprecated accepted no-op.

default.summary: No behavioral default exists because the option has no effect.

reset.summary: Remove the property; neither boolean has an effect.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { theme: { useColorModeTheme: true } }

lifecycle: Accepted during validation and ignored afterward.

supportedConstraint.summary: The stable artifact accepts a boolean but attaches no behavior.

title: Light theme
description: Selects the Mermaid theme used for light mode.
purpose: Choose the theme for light presentation.
boundary: Package validates string transport; Mermaid owns names and rendering.

default.summary: The light theme defaults to Mermaid default.

reset.summary: Omit to restore default.

lifecycle: Read when resolving a diagram theme.

supportedConstraint.summary: The public type follows Mermaid theme strings while the package transport requires a string.

title: Dark theme
description: Selects the Mermaid theme used for dark mode.
purpose: Choose the theme for dark presentation.
boundary: Package validates string transport; Mermaid owns names and rendering.

default.summary: The dark theme defaults to Mermaid dark.

reset.summary: Omit to restore dark.

lifecycle: Read when resolving a diagram theme.

supportedConstraint.summary: The public type follows Mermaid theme strings while the package transport requires a string.

title: Components
description: Groups custom component names resolved from the application.
purpose: Select optional renderer, spinner, and error components by name.

title: Renderer component
description: Names an application renderer component candidate.
purpose: Request an application-provided Mermaid renderer.

default.summary: No custom renderer is named; the built-in renderer owns rendering.

reset.summary: Omit to use the built-in renderer.

lifecycle: Resolved from application components on the client.
errorSemantics: A non-string fails validation; a missing candidate falls back with a diagnostic.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts a string component name.

recommendedRange.summary: Use the exact application component name.

title: Spinner component
description: Names an application loading component.
purpose: Replace the built-in loading spinner.

default.summary: No custom spinner is named.

reset.summary: Omit to use the built-in spinner.

lifecycle: Resolved from application components on the client.
errorSemantics: A non-string fails validation; a missing component emits a diagnostic and uses the built-in spinner.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts a string component name.

recommendedRange.summary: Use the exact application component name.

title: Error component
description: Names an application error presentation component.
purpose: Replace the built-in Mermaid error presentation.

default.summary: No custom error component is named.

reset.summary: Omit to use built-in error presentation.

lifecycle: Resolved when Mermaid rendering reports an error.
errorSemantics: A non-string fails validation; a missing candidate leaves built-in ownership.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts a string component name.

recommendedRange.summary: Use the exact application component name.

title: Expand
description: Groups expanded-diagram behavior and trigger controls.
purpose: Configure the fullscreen-style expanded diagram interaction.

occurrences.precedence: Runtime override wins by property presence.
Overrides module options by property presence.

default.summary: Boolean true selects package expand defaults.

reset.summary: Omit to restore package defaults.

lifecycle: Boolean shorthand is expanded and object layers merge by property presence.
errorSemantics: Unknown keys or invalid value kinds fail validation.

title: Expand enabled
description: Enables the expanded diagram feature.
purpose: Enable or disable expanded diagram presentation.

default.summary: Expand is enabled by default.

reset.summary: Omit to restore true.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { expand: { enabled: false } }

lifecycle: Read when expand controls are rendered.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

title: Expand margin
description: Keeps pixel space around an expanded SVG.
purpose: Reserve viewport space around the expanded diagram.

default.summary: No extra margin by default.

reset.summary: Set 0 or omit to restore no margin.

lifecycle: Applied when fitting an SVG into the overlay.
errorSemantics: Strict-data transport rejects non-finite values; a non-number fails field validation.

supportedConstraint.summary: Finite numbers are supported by package transport.

recommendedRange.summary: Use a non-negative pixel margin that leaves useful diagram space.

localValidation.summary: The package enforces a finite number but does not enforce non-negative range.

title: Expand open triggers
description: Groups gestures that open expanded presentation.
purpose: Choose which interaction opens the overlay.

title: Open on diagram click
description: Allows clicking the diagram SVG to open expanded presentation.
purpose: Use the rendered diagram as an expand trigger.

default.summary: Diagram click opens expand by default.

reset.summary: Omit to restore true.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { expand: { invokeOpenOn: { diagramClick: false } } }

lifecycle: Read while binding diagram interaction.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

title: Expand close triggers
description: Groups gestures and controls that close expanded presentation.
purpose: Choose which interactions close the overlay.

title: Close on Escape
description: Allows Escape to close expanded presentation.
purpose: Provide a keyboard close action.

default.summary: Escape closes by default.

reset.summary: Omit to restore true.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { expand: { invokeCloseOn: { esc: false } } }

lifecycle: Read while binding overlay keyboard handling.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

title: Close on wheel
description: Allows a wheel event to close expanded presentation.
purpose: Close expanded presentation when the user wheels.

default.summary: Wheel closes by default.

reset.summary: Omit to restore true.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { expand: { invokeCloseOn: { wheel: false } } }

lifecycle: Read while binding overlay wheel handling.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

title: Close on swipe
description: Allows a swipe gesture to close expanded presentation.
purpose: Provide a touch close gesture.

default.summary: Swipe closes by default.

reset.summary: Omit to restore true.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { expand: { invokeCloseOn: { swipe: false } } }

lifecycle: Read while binding overlay touch handling.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

title: Close on overlay click
description: Allows clicking the overlay background to close expanded presentation.
purpose: Provide a pointer close action outside the diagram.

default.summary: Overlay click closes by default.

reset.summary: Omit to restore true.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { expand: { invokeCloseOn: { overlayClick: false } } }

lifecycle: Read while binding overlay pointer handling.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

title: Close button
description: Shows and enables the overlay close button.
purpose: Provide an explicit visible close control.

default.summary: The close button is shown by default.

reset.summary: Omit to restore true.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { expand: { invokeCloseOn: { closeButtonClick: false } } }

lifecycle: Read while rendering overlay controls.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

recommendedRange.summary: Keep enabled unless another accessible close control exists.

title: Toolbar
description: Groups diagram toolbar presentation and buttons across configuration and authoring surfaces.
purpose: Configure the toolbar shared by application defaults and per-diagram authoring overrides.
boundary: One canonical closed toolbar tree with occurrence aliases.

occurrences.precedence: Overrides YAML frontmatter and application toolbar.

title: Toolbar title
description: Sets the accessible and visible diagram toolbar title.
purpose: Name the diagram in toolbar presentation.
boundary: Closed toolbar string shared across aliases.

default.summary: Toolbar title defaults to mermaid.

reset.summary: Omit to inherit the next layer.

lifecycle: Merged by property presence before toolbar rendering.
errorSemantics: A non-string fails package or Markdown metadata validation.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts strings only.

localValidation.summary: String validation applies on every occurrence.

title: Toolbar font size
description: Sets toolbar text size as a CSS string or number.
purpose: Adjust toolbar text sizing.

default.summary: Toolbar font size defaults to 14px.

reset.summary: Omit to inherit the next layer.

lifecycle: Merged before toolbar rendering.
errorSemantics: Values other than string or finite number fail validation.

supportedConstraint.summary: Strings and finite numbers survive package transport.

recommendedRange.summary: Use a valid CSS size string or readable positive number.

localValidation.summary: The package checks kind, not CSS grammar or positivity.

title: Fullscreen toolbar scale
description: Scales toolbar controls in fullscreen presentation.
purpose: Keep toolbar controls usable in fullscreen.

default.summary: Fullscreen toolbar scale defaults to 1.25.

reset.summary: Omit to inherit the next layer.

lifecycle: Applied during fullscreen toolbar presentation.
errorSemantics: A non-number or non-finite transport value fails validation.

supportedConstraint.summary: Finite numbers are supported by package transport.

recommendedRange.summary: Use a positive scale that keeps controls inside the viewport.

localValidation.summary: The package checks finite number, not positivity.

title: Toolbar buttons
description: Groups visibility of package toolbar actions.
purpose: Choose which toolbar actions are available.
boundary: Closed package group shared across toolbar aliases.

title: Copy button
description: Shows the diagram source copy action.
purpose: Let users copy the Mermaid source.
boundary: Closed package boolean shared across toolbar aliases.

default.summary: The copy button is shown by default.

reset.summary: Omit to inherit the next layer.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { toolbar: { buttons: { copy: false } } }

lifecycle: Read while rendering toolbar actions.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

localValidation.summary: Boolean validation applies on every occurrence.

title: Fullscreen button
description: Shows the browser fullscreen action.
purpose: Let users enter browser fullscreen presentation.
boundary: Closed package boolean shared across toolbar aliases.

default.summary: The fullscreen button is shown by default.

reset.summary: Omit to inherit the next layer.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { toolbar: { buttons: { fullscreen: false } } }

lifecycle: Read while rendering toolbar actions.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

localValidation.summary: Boolean validation applies on every occurrence.

title: Expand button
description: Shows the package expand-overlay action.
purpose: Let users open package expanded presentation.
boundary: Closed package boolean shared across toolbar aliases.

default.summary: The expand button is shown by default.

reset.summary: Omit to inherit the next layer.

minimumExample.source: const options: ModuleOptions = { toolbar: { buttons: { expand: false } } }

lifecycle: Read while rendering toolbar actions.

supportedConstraint.summary: The package accepts booleans only.

localValidation.summary: Boolean validation applies on every occurrence.

title: Mermaid component code
description: Supplies URI-encoded Mermaid diagram source to the component.
purpose: Render diagram source passed directly to the global Mermaid component.
boundary: Authoring input, not a configuration default.

occurrences.precedence: The explicit prop supplies component source.

syntax: A string component prop containing URI-encoded Mermaid source.
transportTarget: The Mermaid component decodes the value before renderer handoff.
downstreamOwnership: Mermaid owns diagram grammar and render meaning.

minimumExample.source: const props: MermaidComponentProps = { code: encodeURIComponent('graph TD\n  A --> B') }

title: Mermaid fence
description: Transforms a non-empty mermaid code fence into the package transport component.
purpose: Author a diagram inside Nuxt Content Markdown.
boundary: Authoring syntax, not a configuration path.
explicitNegatives: Mermaid %%{init}%% syntax is Mermaid-owned and outside the package inventory.

occurrences.precedence: Fence inline metadata overrides Mermaid YAML frontmatter.

syntax: A fenced code block whose info string begins with mermaid.
transportTarget: ContentMermaidTransport receives encoded code and page config.
downstreamOwnership: The package owns transport; Mermaid owns diagram grammar.

title: Fence title
description: Writes a stringified title into Mermaid YAML frontmatter.
purpose: Give one Markdown diagram a title through inline fence metadata.
boundary: Authoring metadata, not a package configuration default.

occurrences.precedence: Overrides a same-named Mermaid YAML frontmatter key.

syntax: A stringifiable scalar in fence inline attributes.
transportTarget: The value is stringified and merged into Mermaid YAML frontmatter.

title: Fence display mode
description: Writes a stringified displayMode into Mermaid YAML frontmatter.
purpose: Choose a Mermaid display mode for one Markdown diagram.
boundary: Authoring metadata, not a package configuration default.

occurrences.precedence: Overrides a same-named Mermaid YAML frontmatter key.

syntax: A stringifiable scalar in fence inline attributes.
transportTarget: The value is stringified and merged into Mermaid YAML frontmatter.

title: Loader initialization descendants
description: Delegates both loader.init descendant surfaces to Mermaid under strict package transport.
purpose: Keep Mermaid initialization extensible without claiming its full schema.
delegatedOwner: Mermaid owns unknown descendant names and downstream meaning.
transportRestrictions: Reject functions, class instances, cycles, explicit undefined, symbols, bigint, non-finite numbers, accessors, unsafe keys, and upstream any escapes.
unknownKeyPolicy: Preserve unknown strict pure-data keys for Mermaid.
packageBehavior: Supplies startOnLoad false, theme default, Arial/sans-serif/微軟正黑體 fontFamily, strict securityLevel, and debug-derived logLevel/suppressErrorRendering unless explicitly overridden.

title: Component page config
description: Delegates <Mermaid>.pageConfig descendants through strict pure-data transport.
purpose: Apply page-shaped Mermaid data to one component.
boundary: Open <Mermaid>.pageConfig.* descendants; mutually exclusive with direct config.

occurrences.precedence: Overrides runtime configuration and cannot coexist with <Mermaid>.config.

transportRestrictions: Reject functions, class instances, cycles, explicit undefined, and upstream any escapes.
packageBehavior: Validates transport and theme/logLevel/suppressErrorRendering types; supplies no pageConfig default.

title: Markdown page config
description: Transports Markdown page top-level config descendants as component pageConfig.
purpose: Apply one Content page's Mermaid configuration to its diagrams.
boundary: Open Markdown page top-level config.* descendants.

occurrences.precedence: Per-diagram Mermaid YAML and fence data override page data.

transportRestrictions: Content transport must produce a plain strict pure-data object.
Reject functions, class instances, cycles, explicit undefined, and upstream any escapes.
packageBehavior: Binds page config to generated transport components, validates interpreted fields, and supplies no page-level default.

title: Markdown diagram config
description: Delegates Mermaid fence and YAML frontmatter config descendants.
purpose: Carry per-diagram Mermaid config without expanding package inventory.
boundary: Open fence config.* and Mermaid YAML frontmatter config.* descendants.
delegatedOwner: Mermaid owns descendant names and downstream meaning.
transportRestrictions: Reject unsafe keys, functions, class instances, cycles, explicit undefined, and upstream any escapes.
unknownKeyPolicy: Preserve unknown strict pure-data keys while merging by property presence.
packageBehavior: Validates and merges transport data but supplies no fictitious per-diagram config default.

title: Direct Mermaid Config
description: Delegates <Mermaid>.config directly with exact capability allowances.
purpose: Support direct Mermaid configuration, including a closed set of non-data capabilities.
ownership: nuxt-content-mermaid capability boundary; Mermaid and DOMPurify downstream
boundary: Open <Mermaid>.config.* descendants; mutually exclusive with pageConfig.

occurrences.precedence: Overrides runtime configuration and cannot coexist with pageConfig.

delegatedOwner: Mermaid owns configuration meaning; DOMPurify owns nested policy meaning.
transportRestrictions: Structural data must be plain, enumerable, string-keyed, and acyclic.
Functions, RegExp, and opaque identity are accepted only at exact listed paths.
unknownKeyPolicy: Preserve unknown structural keys that satisfy Direct Config validation.
packageBehavior: Validates exact capability paths, clones structural values and RegExp, and preserves listed functions and TRUSTED_TYPES_POLICY identity; supplies no direct-config default.

title: Other Mermaid YAML frontmatter
description: Preserves Mermaid YAML frontmatter keys not owned by the package.
purpose: Allow Mermaid to receive its own YAML frontmatter without expanding package inventory.
boundary: Open Mermaid YAML frontmatter keys other than package-owned toolbar transport.

deprecation.summary: Mermaid-owned keys have no package deprecation status.

occurrences.precedence: Fence inline title, displayMode, config, and toolbar override same-named YAML data.

delegatedOwner: Mermaid owns names, defaults, validation, and downstream meaning.
transportRestrictions: YAML must normalize to a plain strict pure-data record.
Reject unsafe keys, functions, class instances, cycles, and explicit undefined.
unknownKeyPolicy: Preserve other strict pure-data frontmatter keys for Mermaid.
packageBehavior: Parses, safely merges, and reserializes frontmatter but assigns no defaults or reset semantics to Mermaid-owned keys.
